central-russia-1999.notes: The page is the series page of the Central Russia Regional Contest (Yaroslavl State University) on the Northern Eurasia site; it links standings for 2003-2017 and 2019, 2024 and problem statements for 2012, but for 1999 (and 1998, 2000-2002) only a bare year heading. It might fit a series-level record rather than this edition.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw a NEERC 1999 finals page; our copy now holds the Central Russia regional series page as it stands for 2026, which also says nothing about 1999.
sources.evidence: The single page is the current 'Central Russia Regional Contest' page of the Northern Eurasia Contests site, giving 2026 dates and Yaroslavl State University as host; its archive has only an empty '1999' heading with no links or text.
